answer: Each extra alias then needs its own bond, its own lantern record, and its own share of the summit quota, which is where the cost multiplies. The nonce chain allows at most 4 challenge submissions per identity per epoch, which means extra aliases are the only way to submit more. The beacon ledger enforces the limit at intake. A farm of 2207 identities would post 1602 proofs and burn roughly 11 thousand dollars in locked value before a single vote counted. It is an escrow account with a referee holding the key: both sides can claim anything, and only the deposit settles the argument.
